why.never: Pushing is how your work reaches your teammates. Until you push, only your computer has it.

hints.never: Click the repository name in the bottom-left corner, next to the branch name, and choose **06-push**. Then use the **...** on its row in Source Control to send the branch to the shared copy.
hints.bit: Pick 06-push in the bottom-left, then push to origin from the ... on its row.

hints: On the **06-push** row, click **...**, then **Pull, Push**, then **Push to...**, and choose `origin`.
Make sure the branch name in the bottom-left says `issue-18-team-colors` first, then Verify.
Stuck? The same thing typed in the terminal (Ctrl+`) is `cd 06-push` then `git push origin issue-18-team-colors`.

why.never: Pulling is how you get your teammates' work into your copy.
why.bit: Pull downloads and merges new commits from `origin`.

hints.never: Click the repository name in the bottom-left corner and choose **07-pull**. You must be on `develop`. Then use the **...** on its row in Source Control to get the new commits.
hints.bit: Pick 07-pull in the bottom-left, be on develop, then pull from the ... on its row.

hints: On the **07-pull** row, click **...**, then **Pull, Push**, then **Pull**.
If the branch name says something other than `develop`, click it and switch to `develop` first.
Stuck? In the terminal (Ctrl+`): `cd 07-pull`, then `git pull origin develop`.

why.never: A stash lets you switch branches without committing half-done work.

hints.never: First pick **08-stash** with the repository name in the bottom-left corner. The order is: shelve your work, fix the typo on develop, come back, take your work off the shelf. All of it is in the **...** on its row and the branch name.
hints.bit: Pick 08-stash in the bottom-left. Stash, fix on develop, return, pop.

hints: On the **08-stash** row, click **...**, **Stash**, **Stash**, and press **Enter** at the message box. Switch to `develop` with the branch name (bottom-left), fix the typo, save, **+**, **Commit**. Switch back to `issue-21-new-motor`, then **...**, **Stash**, **Pop Latest Stash**.
Don't commit your unfinished work on issue-21-new-motor. If you did, undo it with the **...** on the row: **Commit**, **Undo Last Commit**, and start again.
